title.zh: CoinEx to cease operation after 9 years, citing ‘significant’ crypto contraction

current_state.zh: CoinEx announced it is winding down operations after nine years, citing prolonged market contraction, falling trading volumes and liquidity, and rising regulatory and compliance costs, with withdrawals open until Dec. 22.
